about: Messy-dictation -> expected-clean pairs for the local LLM cleanup benchmark. Inputs are written to look like whisper.cpp output (it already emits some punctuation/casing). Expected outputs follow the cleanup prompt rules at level=light, style=formal; lists as <ol>/<ul> HTML (the clone converts to plain text later). Authored for this repo (no third-party text).
